title: Why 1st July is special for CAs
text: ICAI was set up on 1 July 1949 under the Chartered Accountants Act, 1949. That's why 1st July is celebrated every year as CA Day.

title: Same birthday: CA Day & GST Day
text: GST was launched in India on 1 July 2017 – the same date as CA Day. So 1st July is both CA Day and GST Day!

title: Your exam pattern: 30 marks MCQs
text: Under the new scheme, CA Intermediate papers have 30 marks of case-scenario MCQs and 70 marks of descriptive questions. Daily MCQ practice in this group = practice for that 30%!

title: Exemption rule – know it!
text: Score 60 or more in a paper but miss the group? You get an exemption in that paper for the next three consecutive attempts under the new scheme.

title: Pass marks at CA Inter
text: To pass a group you need at least 40 marks in each paper and 50% aggregate in that group.

title: ICAI's motto
text: ICAI's motto is from the Kathopanishad: 'Ya Eshu Supteshu Jagarti' – one who is awake in those who sleep. A CA keeps watch on behalf of the public.

title: Where does the word 'Audit' come from?
text: 'Audit' comes from the Latin word 'audire' – to hear. In early times, accounts were read out aloud and the auditor 'heard' them.

title: Father of Accounting
text: Luca Pacioli, an Italian mathematician, described the double-entry system in his book 'Summa' in 1494. He is called the Father of Accounting.

title: Taxation paper split
text: CA Inter Paper 3 (Taxation) is 100 marks: Section A Income Tax – 50 marks, Section B GST – 50 marks. Don't neglect either half!

title: Five regions of ICAI
text: ICAI has five regional councils: Western (Mumbai), Southern (Chennai), Eastern (Kolkata), Central (Kanpur) and Northern (New Delhi).

title: Who writes Accounting Standards?
text: The Accounting Standards Board (ASB) of ICAI was set up in 1977 to formulate Accounting Standards in India – the AS you study in Advanced Accounting.

title: Articleship is now 2 years
text: Under the new scheme of education and training, practical training (articleship) is 2 years.

title: Study tip: Revise in cycles
text: Revise a topic after 1 day, 7 days and 30 days. Spaced revision makes concepts stick far better than one long reading.

title: Study tip: MCQs = concept test
text: When you get an MCQ wrong, don't just read the answer – find WHY your option was wrong. Traps repeat in exams.
